scope: humans †1095–1131 holding an office (P39) or noble title (P97) of the Latin East: King of Jerusalem, Queen of Jerusalem, Prince of Antioch, Count of Tripoli, Count of Edessa, Prince of Galilee, Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem, Constable of Jerusalem, Lord of Sidon, Lord of Beirut, Lord of Caesarea, Lord of Oultrejordain, Lord of Toron, Lord of Ramla, Count of Jaffa and Ascalon
query: SELECT DISTINCT ?p ?pLabel ?birth ?death ?desc WHERE { ?pos rdfs:label ?pl . FILTER(?pl IN ("King of Jerusalem"@en, "Queen of Jerusalem"@en, "Prince of Antioch"@en, "Count of Tripoli"@en, "Count of Edessa"@en, "Prince of Galilee"@en, "Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem"@en, "Constable of Jerusalem"@en, "Lord of Sidon"@en, "Lord of Beirut"@en, "Lord of Caesarea"@en, "Lord of Oultrejordain"@en, "Lord of Toron"@en, "Lord of Ramla"@en, "Count of Jaffa and Ascalon"@en)) { ?p wdt:P39 ?pos } UNION { ?p wdt:P97 ?pos } ?p wdt:P31 wd:Q5 . ?p wdt:P570 ?d . FILTER(YEAR(?d) >= 1095 && YEAR(?d) <= 1131) OPTIONAL { ?p wdt:P569 ?birth } OPTIONAL { ?p wdt:P570 ?death } OPTIONAL { ?p schema:description ?desc FILTER(LANG(?desc)="en") } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,fr,de,la". } }
